title: Incognito Mode Risk Calculator - Test Your Privacy Protection
metaDescription: Calculate your real privacy risk when using incognito mode. Discover what data you're still exposed to and get personalized protection tips.
description: Evaluate how well incognito mode protects your privacy based on your browsing habits and activities. Get a personalized risk score and see what private browsing leaves exposed, from your network to the sites you sign in to.

formula: let baseRisk = 40; let blockingMultipliers = {none: 1.0, cookies: 0.9, trackers: 0.8, unsure: 1.0}; let activityRisks = {shopping: 15, banking: 25, social: 20, research: 10, streaming: 12}; let networkRisks = {home: 5, work: 15, public: 30, mobile: 10}; let frequencyMultiplier = frequency * 0.1; let toolsReduction = additionalTools ? -15: 0; let sharedRisk = sharedDevice ? 20: 0; let totalRisk = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseRisk * (blockingMultipliers[privateModeBlocking] ?? 1.0) + activityRisks[activities] + networkRisks[networkType] + (frequencyMultiplier * 10) + toolsReduction + sharedRisk))); let grade = totalRisk <= 25 ? 'A': totalRisk <= 40 ? 'B': totalRisk <= 60 ? 'C': 'D'; let exposurePercent = Math.round(totalRisk * 0.8); return {riskScore: totalRisk, protectionLevel: grade, exposurePercentage: exposurePercent};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your privacy risk by analyzing whether your private mode blocks trackers, your online activities, network environment, and additional security measures. It accounts for the fact that incognito mode only prevents local data storage, not network-level tracking or ISP monitoring.
tips: Combine incognito mode with a VPN for better network-level privacy protection
Check whether your private mode blocks trackers; if it doesn't, turn on strict tracking protection or add a tracker blocker
Avoid banking or sensitive activities on public WiFi, even in incognito mode
Remember that incognito mode doesn't hide your activity from your ISP or network administrator
Sign out of accounts before a private session; a site you're signed in to knows who you are in any mode

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy protection. You're using incognito mode effectively with additional security measures.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Decent protection but room for improvement. Consider adding a VPN or switching to a more private browser.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy gaps. Your data is still quite trackable despite using incognito mode.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Poor privacy protection. You need additional tools beyond incognito mode to protect your data.
